behavior: Agile bark forager that zigzags along trunks and branches, probing crevices and sometimes using bark chips as tools. Often travels in pairs or family groups, caches seeds, and nests or roosts in tree cavities.
field_marks: Warm brown cap extending to the dark eye above a pale cheek
Blue-gray back and rounded wings with darker flight feathers
Whitish throat and underparts, often washed pale buff
Tiny, round-bodied profile with a short, square-tipped tail
Dark gray legs with strong feet and curved claws for gripping bark
habitat: Open, mature pine woodland with a sparse understory and standing dead or decaying trees for nesting; less frequent in mixed pine-hardwood forest.
